```python
def validate_request(self, request):
    token = None
    
    # Try to get token from Authorization header (Bearer only)
    if hasattr(request, 'headers') and request.headers:
        auth_header = request.headers.get('Authorization', '')
        if auth_header.startswith('Bearer '):
            token = auth_header[7:]  # Remove 'Bearer ' prefix
    
    # Fall back to access_token attribute if no Bearer token found
    if token is None and hasattr(request, 'access_token'):
        token = request.access_token
    
    return self.request_validator.validate_jwt_bearer_token(
        token, request.scopes, request)
```
